questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Have money saved
2. Have patience with all the practical things (mobility online, learning agreement, Erasmus scholarship)
3. Enjoy the amazing city
